source_records.title: Accepted X reception ledger r3 (27 direct observations, 27 accounts, 24 independent)
source_records.summary_text: Sol-reviewed r3 correction: 27 direct X observations with 27 unique status URLs and 27 unique accounts (24 independent, 2 vendor/project-affiliated, 1 runtime/implementation-maintainer); primary modality image 11 / speech-audio 4 / music 3 / video 8 / mechanism-cross-modal 1; raw FIRST_HAND 22/1/4, downstream normalized OBS-SPEECH-01 YES->NO gives 21/2/4; reception 14 positive / 5 mixed / 3 negative / 5 neutral; categories FIRST_HAND_CREATOR_WORKFLOW 11 / DEPLOYMENT 3 / BENCHMARK 3 / FAILURE 3 / INDEPENDENT_TECHNICAL_ANALYSIS 3 / ADOPTION_SIGNAL 2 / RUNTIME_MAINTAINER 1 / OFFICIAL_OR_VENDOR 1. Reception/deployment value: local/on-device FLUX.2 [klein] deployment and latency friction, Seedream character/reference consistency reception, speech full-duplex adoption interest with weak matched latency evidence, music creator-workflow adoption, Seedance/Kling consistency and editing-failure comparisons, Wan2.2 GGUF/ComfyUI consumer-hardware constraints, identity/detail damage on edits, temporal/spatial drift and lip-sync as continuing video failure modes. Duplicate OBS-MECH-01 removed, OBS-VID-08 retained as canonical video failure with secondary mechanism/counter-signal tag. Sparse lanes (full-duplex interruption/overlap measurement, cross-lingual/emotion cloning degradation, long-range music structure, metrics-vs-preference contradictions, Nano Banana independent editing corpus, controlled few-step ablations) remain explicitly LOW_SIGNAL and are not inflated. [retrieval: IMPORTED_RAW; X is reception/deployment/counter-signal observation only, not sole technical authority; any technical claim promoted from an X lead must be rebound to primary/independent technical authority at Evidence; no popularity ranking or model winner derived]

metadata.evidence_boundary: source-local claims only until Evidence verification; X must not be sole authority for architecture, specification, dates, licenses, prices, benchmark scores, or causal technical claims
